## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Barcelona, Spain. It starts at Carrer de València, 284.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Give the sands of time a shake, and travel back to the glory days of ancient Egypt on a self-guided expedition around the Egyptian Museum of Barcelona.
>
> Marvel at age-old artifacts, mummies, cursed tombs, sculptures, jewelry, weapons, and statues of ancient gods, while a captivating audio guide takes your imagination time-traveling 5,000 years into the past, placing each item in its historical context in fascinating detail.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €15.31. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 95 ratings and 63 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
